notes.title: Visual Update – Advanced Fisher Customization
notes.notes:
This update focuses entirely on enhancing the game's visuals, introducing a brand-new model for the fisher character along with an expanded customization system. Now you can express your style like never before!

What’s new:

    Customize individual parts of the character with your chosen colors

    Choose from a variety of new hairstyles

    Pick from a selection of stylish hats

Show off your unique look as you cast your line and explore the waters with a fisher that truly represents you!
